content: Sɑɑ ye sɔɔ, Gusunɔn sɔmɔ Asee kɑ Sɑkɑri Idon bii bɑ Gusunɔn ɡɑri ɡeruɑ kɑ Gusunɔ Isirelibɑn Yinnin yĩsiru Yerusɑlɛmuɔ kɑ Yudɑbɑn tem kpuro sɔɔ.
Yerɑ Sorobɑbɛli, Seɑlitiɛlin bii kɑ Yosue, Yosɑdɑkin bii bɑ seewɑ bɑ Yinni Gusunɔn sɑ̃ɑ yee te bɑnɑ toruɑ Yerusɑlɛmuɔ. Mɑ Gusunɔn sɔmɔ be, bɑ bu somimɔ.

Sɑɑ ye sɔɔrɑ Tɑtinɑi, berɑ ye yɑ wɑ̃ɑ Efɑrɑtin ɡuru ɡeen kpɑro kɑ Setɑɑ Bosinɑi kɑ ben sɔm kowosibu bɑ nɑ bɑ bu deemɑ bɑ nɛɛ, wɑrɑ u bɛɛ woodɑ wɛ̃ i kɑ dii te bɑnimɔ. Wɑrɑ u bɛɛ woodɑ wɛ̃ i kɑ ɡbɑ̃rɑ te seeyɑmɔ.
Tɛ̃, be bɑ bɑni yi mɔ̀ i sun ben yĩsɑ wɛ̃ɛmɑ.
Adɑmɑ Gusunɔ u kɑ Yuubɑn bukuro be wɑ̃ɑ mɑ bɑ ben sɔmburu mɔ̀ bɑ dɔɔ bɑ kɑ mɑrɑ tireru tu turi sinɑ boko Dɑrusin mi, kpɑ wi, u mɑɑ bu wisimɑ.
Bɑ Yuubɑ kɔrumɔtɔnu kuɑ
Dɑrusin mi
Be bɑ sinɑ boko Dɑrusi tireru yoruɑ Yuubɑn sɔ̃ ben yĩsɑ wee, Tɑtinɑi berɑ min wiruɡii kɑ Setɑɑ Bosinɑi kɑ wiruɡii be bɑ wɑ̃ɑ Efɑrɑtin ɡuru ɡee, sɔ̃ɔ duu yeru ɡiɑ.
Wee ye bɑ ɡeruɑ tire te sɔɔ. Bɑ nɛɛ, sinɑ boko Dɑrusi, Gusunɔ u nun ɑlɑfiɑ kɛ̃.
Wee sɑ nun nɔɔsiɑmɔ mɑ sɑ dɑ Yudɑbɑn temɔ sere Yinni Gusunɔn sɑ̃ɑ yerɔ. Bɑ tu bɑnɑwɑ kɑ kpee bɑkɑnu mɑ bɑ ten ɡɑni dɑ̃ɑ wukirimɔ tɛ̃. Sɔmbu te, tɑ dɔɔ ɡem ɡem.
Mɑ sɑ ben bukurobu bikiɑ sɑ nɛɛ, wɑrɑ u bu woodɑ wɛ̃ bu kɑ dii te bɑni kpɑ bu ten ɡɑni seeyɑ.
Mɑ sɑ ben yĩsɑ bikiɑ kpɑ su wɑ su kɑ nun ye mɔrisiɑmɑ.

Wee ye bɑ sun wisɑ. Bɑ nɛɛ, bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ Gusunɔ wɔllu kɑ tem Yinnin sɔm kowobu. Yerɑ bɑ win sɑ̃ɑ yeru seeyɑmɔ te bɑ rɑɑ nùn bɑniɑ sɑɑ yellun di. Be, Isirelibɑn sinɑ boko wi u yĩsiru yɑrɑ, wiyɑ u rɑɑ tu bɑnɑ.
Adɑmɑ ye ben bɑɑbɑbɑ bɑ Wɔrukoon mɔru seeyɑ, yerɑ u bu Bɑbilonin sinɑ boko Nɛbukɑnɛsɑɑ nɔmu sɔndiɑ. Yerɑ sinɑ boko wi, u Yinni Gusunɔn sɑ̃ɑ yee te kɔsukɑ. Mɑ u bu ɡurɑ u kɑ dɑ win temɔ.
Yen biruwɑ Sirusi Bɑbilonin sinɑ boko u woodɑ wɛ̃ win bɑndun wɔ̃ɔ ɡbiikuu sɔɔ bu dɑ bu Yinni Gusunɔn sɑ̃ɑ yee te bɑni.

N deemɑ sinɑ boko Nɛbukɑnɛsɑɑwɑ u rɑɑ Yinni Gusunɔn sɑ̃ɑ yerun dendi yɑ̃ɑ ni bɑ kuɑ kɑ wurɑ kɑ sii ɡeesu ɡurɑmɑ sɑɑ Yerusɑlɛmun di u doke ben bũu dirɔ. Yerɑ Sirusi u dendi yɑ̃ɑ ni suɑ bũu dii ten min di u Sesibɑsɑɑ wɛ̃ wi u kuɑ Isirelibɑn tem kpɑro.
Mɑ u Sesibɑsɑɑ sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, u doo u dendi yɑ̃ɑ ni doke Yerusɑlɛmun sɑ̃ɑ yerɔ kpɑ u de bu mɑɑ Yinni Gusunɔn sɑ̃ɑ yee ten bɑnsu seeyɑ mi bɑ rɑɑ tu bɑnɑ.
Sesibɑsɑɑ wi, u nɑ u sɑ̃ɑ yee ten kpɛɛkpɛɛku swĩi Yerusɑlɛmuɔ. Sɑɑ yen dɔmɑ ten di, bɑ bɑnɑ toruɑ. Adɑmɑ sere kɑ ɡisɔ, bɑ ǹ tu kpɑ.
Yen sɔ̃, ǹ n wunɛ sinɑ boko wɛ̃re, ɑ de bu kɑsu sinɑmbun fɑɑɡin tireru sɔɔ, Sirusi ù n woodɑ wɛ̃ɛre bu Yinni Gusunɔn sɑ̃ɑ yee te seeyɑ Yerusɑlɛmuɔ, kpɑ ɑ sun sɔ̃ɔmɑ ye ɑ kĩ bɑnɑ yen sɔ̃.
Dɑrusi u woodɑ wɛ̃
bu Sirusin woodɑ ye kɑsu
